title: One position drives several frequency clocks
purpose: Compare the two coordinate planes of a four-channel rotary prefix.
contract: R = 4 and theta = 100 produce frequencies 1 and 0.1 radians per token.
Position 1 rotates each unit basis vector by its own frequency; these are not learned vectors.
